title: nothopanax × parvus
intro: Nothopanax × parvus, commonly known as the Variegated Pittosporum, is a hybrid ornamental plant species in the Pittosporaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Nothopanax × parvus include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal activities, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids.
